clips.title: The story
paras: Dustwind harpies hold Drygulch Ravine, where they menace nearby supply caravans. The gorge lies among eastern Durotar's rocky bluffs, reached by a cave passage from Razorwind Canyon or a perilous drop from above.

In the crags east of Orgrimmar, Drygulch Ravine forms a sheltered depression and a lawless pocket of Durotar. A cramped natural tunnel from Razorwind Canyon is its only ground-level route. Dustwind harpies roost along the steep cliffs, where they nest their broods and stockpile goods stolen from Horde supply trains on the regional trails.

Dustwind harpies are the ravine's immediate danger. Their matriarchs fiercely defend clutches of eggs tucked along the high ledges. Horde scouts often send young warriors to thin the flock, recover plundered trade crates, and break the harpies' hold on the ravine.
